source.title: TKDL: Hibiscus tiliaceus — Luwago (Tagabawa), Malabago (Tagalog)
source.limitation: An ethnographic bark-sap account, not a clinical trial, edible-leaf cooking method, recommended dose or proof of oral safety. Source dosing and harvesting-belief instructions are not adopted. Origin retrieval timed out; the reviewed web-tool page extract is not a fresh origin response.

sourceProvenance.summary: DOST-PCHRD identifies tkdlph.com as the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library in its 2016 APEC workshop notice. This supports historical project provenance, not a 2026 clinical endorsement or a claim that tkdl.ph and tkdlph.com are interchangeable.

proposal.preparationPart: Pale inner bark; not young leaves, calyces or roots
proposal.preparationDescription: TKDL records a Tagabawa practice for Hibiscus tiliaceus in which the pale inner bark is pressed to obtain sap, in an account concerning cough. This describes documented traditional practice, not a safe home recipe or treatment. No medicinal dose, schedule, child-use guidance or clinical efficacy is established by this record.
